# osapi dsl command

List, describe and validate the local commands, and print their DSL.
`osapi dsl command get --name dsl command` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                                     |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | dsl command                                                         |
| Description | List, describe and validate the local commands, and print their DSL |

| Method      | list                                                         |

|             |                                                                               |
